Click this button ![Image p187](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp187-img1.png) to open Points to DXF tool.
Allows for easy reference point transfer between the CE Express interface and CAD applications.
![Image p187](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp187-img2.png)
**DXF options**
**Marker**
Type of marker to draw
**Marker radius**
Size of marker
**Label**
Draw number labels next to the points
**Label line**
Draw line from the labels to the points
**Label offset**
How far to place the labels from the points
**Point options**
**Layer name**
Output points are placed into different layers. New points are placed into this layer upon map click. Point layer may be changed after the fact within the line for each point in the UI.
![Image p188](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp188-img1.png)
